pool: 250 complete support-* conversations from Langfuse (stale support-0031 first attempt excluded)

b1-cluster.method: KMeans k=8 (20 restarts, numpy), nearest-to-centroid, 1-2 per cluster
b1-cluster.features: role one-hot, turn count, tool-call count, distinct tools, log reply length, tool-used flags; no outcome fields

b2-intent.method: stratified random by intent; dimension chosen by the student before seeing outcomes

b3-depth.method: depth searches for candidate modes plus close negatives; retrieval signals (keyword, tool-call, threshold and data-quality filters) rank unreviewed conversations, the agent reads the top hits and posts each as a pending suggestion; signals are not labels

b4-uniform.method: uniform random from unreviewed conversations, after the taxonomy draft

d-search.method: Part D searches for thin modes over all 250 conversations: deterministic filters (eligible refund vs threshold vs issue_refund call; writes after empty or multi-result lookups; multi-turn sessions with writes; personal-data request phrases). Every hit read by the agent and posted as a pending suggestion; not counted toward the four required batches.
d-search.routes_search_1: routes search 1: denial signal (eligible false / not_eligible / disputable false) AND reply offers human review, exception, ticket or dispute
